title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: archive files classified as one object on Windows
summary: The briefing accurately reports Microsoft's notice, including the affected organisations, unchanged policy evaluation and rollout windows. The updated licensing page still supports the stated Endpoint DLP entitlement, and the audit-search path and PowerShell command are documented.

claims.where: title; front matter: products; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: This change concerns Microsoft Purview Endpoint Data Loss Prevention on Windows endpoints.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention-Archive File Classification Behavior Change for Windows Endpoints

claims.quote: "status": "In development"

claims.quote: "previewDate": "September CY2026"

claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability", "Preview"]

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Scope
claims.claim: The affected organisations use Endpoint DLP on Windows endpoints with archive file classification enabled.
claims.quote: Organizations using Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP on Windows endpoints with archive file classification enabled

claims.claim: Archive files such as .zip and .rar will be classified directly.
claims.quote: Archive files such as .zip and .rar files will be classified directly.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The archive is classified as a single atomic object rather than separate constituent classification operations.
claims.quote: Classification of archive files will occur as a single, atomic operation.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Files inside an archive will no longer generate separate classification events.
claims.quote: Individual files contained within an archive will no longer generate separate classification events.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Only the outer archive file will be reported in Endpoint DLP events.
claims.quote: Only the outer archive file will be reported in Endpoint DLP events.

claims.claim: Microsoft says the change aligns Windows endpoint classification with classification across Microsoft cloud workloads.
claims.quote: to align with classification behavior across Microsoft cloud workloads

claims.claim: Microsoft says the change improves consistency in classification results.
claims.quote: This change improves consistency in classification results

claims.claim: Microsoft says the change reduces event-reporting noise.
claims.quote: reduces event-reporting noise

claims.claim: Microsoft says the change enhances performance when processing archive files.
claims.quote: enhances performance when processing archive files

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Context-based policy evaluation continues to apply to content within archive files.
claims.quote: Context-based and sensitivity label-based policy evaluation will continue to apply to content within archive files.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Sensitivity label-based policy evaluation continues to apply to content within archive files.
claims.quote: Context-based and sensitivity label-based policy evaluation will continue to apply to content within archive files.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Existing DLP policy behaviour for evaluating content within archives is unchanged.
claims.quote: Existing DLP policy behavior for evaluating content within archive files is unchanged.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft requires no administrator configuration changes for this update.
claims.quote: No administrator configuration changes are required.

claims.claim: No user action is required.
claims.quote: No user action is required.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters
claims.claim: The default state is on: the change reaches the affected organisations without an administrator choosing the update.
claims.quote: Organizations using Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP on Windows endpoints with archive file classification enabled; No administrator configuration changes are required.

claims.claim: The Endpoint DLP Learn page lists monitored archive formats including .zip, .rar, .7z and .tar.
claims.quote: | Archive | Zip, RAR, 7z, TAR | `.zip, .rar, .7z, .tar, .gz, .arj, .bz2, .cab, .chm, .lzh, .lzma, .mhtml, .xar, .xz` |

claims.claim: The cited Endpoint DLP Learn page does not describe the new single-object archive-classification behaviour at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: "Endpoint DLP" "archive" "atomic"; opened learn.microsoft.com/purview/endpoint-dlp-learn-about and searched its full text for archive, atomic and classification. It lists archive types but not the new atomic/outer-only behaviour.

claims.claim: The notice does not say that the change reads any new data.
claims.quote: Searched: "Endpoint DLP" "archive file classification" "data" "automated actions"; read MC1474107 in full and opened Learn about Endpoint data loss prevention. The notice describes classification/reporting changes, not additional data access.

claims.claim: No change to identity or roles is described for this archive-classification update.
claims.quote: Searched: "Endpoint DLP" "archive" "classification" "identity" "roles"; read MC1474107 in full and opened the Endpoint DLP overview, Audit search and Activity explorer pages. No identity or role change is described for this update.

claims.claim: No new automated action is described for this update.
claims.quote: Searched: "Endpoint DLP" "archive file classification" "data" "automated actions"; read MC1474107 in full and opened the Endpoint DLP overview. The notice says existing DLP policy evaluation is unchanged and describes no new automated action.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: A licence specific to this archive-classification behaviour change is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: "Endpoint DLP" "archive" "classification" "license" "charge"; opened Microsoft Purview service description and Learn about Endpoint data loss prevention; read MC1474107. Found product entitlement, not a licence specific to this change.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A charge specific to this archive-classification behaviour change is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: "Endpoint DLP" "archive" "classification" "license" "charge"; opened Purview service description and Endpoint DLP overview; read MC1474107. Search results distinguish separately billed on-demand scans, not a charge for this reporting change.

claims.claim: Neither the roadmap record nor MC1474107 describes a meter or consumption charge for the change.
claims.quote: Searched: "Endpoint DLP" "archive" "classification" "license" "charge"; read the roadmap record and MC1474107 in full. Neither describes a meter or consumption charge; the service description lists Endpoint DLP as included.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends reviewing internal documentation that describes archive file classification.
claims.quote: Review internal documentation that describes archive file classification behavior.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft recommends updating operational and monitoring procedures that reference individual event generation for files inside archives.
claims.quote: Update operational and monitoring procedures if they reference individual event generation for files contained within archives.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends telling compliance and security teams that reports will show outer archive files instead of individual files inside them.
claims.quote: Inform compliance and security teams that Endpoint DLP reporting will show events for the outer archive file instead of individual files within the archive.

claims.claim: Audit search is reached in the Microsoft Purview portal through Audit > Search.
claims.quote: Select the **Audit** solution card. If the **Audit** solution card isn't displayed, select **View all solutions** and then select **Audit** from the **Core** section. ... On the **Search** page, configure the following search criteria as applicable:

claims.claim: Search-UnifiedAuditLog -StartDate <ExDateTime> -EndDate <ExDateTime> searches the unified audit log for the specified date range.
claims.quote:
Search-UnifiedAuditLog
    -EndDate <ExDateTime>
    -StartDate <ExDateTime>

You can search for all events in a specified date range

claims.claim: The listed audit control performs read-only review rather than switching the classification behaviour on or off.
claims.quote: Use the Search-UnifiedAuditLog cmdlet to search the unified audit log.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Audit log searching requires the Audit Logs or View-Only Audit Logs roles.
claims.quote: You must be assigned the *Audit Logs* or *View-Only Audit Logs* roles in the Microsoft Purview portal to search the audit log. ... To access audit cmdlets, you must be assigned the *Audit Logs* or *View-Only Audit Logs* roles in the Exchange admin center.

claims.claim: Search-UnifiedAuditLog runs in Exchange Online PowerShell.
claims.quote: The Search-UnifiedAuditLog cmdlet is available in Exchange Online PowerShell.

claims.claim: The audit-search control operates at tenant scope.
claims.quote: None (Default): Unrestricted admin | All administrative units are available | Access to all activity logs from any user, nonuser, or system account.
